scope.position: world target inverse mount and experiment TCP to native base/flange; no station frame or TCP assignment
scope.checks: representative model knots or edge probes, not validation of every motion segment
scope.native_collision: 15 non-adjacent station robot pairs; stand cross-check is a separate temporary box. Neither validates the physical workcell/head/hose.
scope.station_active_tool: Apply the station flange-to-active-TCP transform numerically to the same world TCP target. Compare seeded FK tolerance and native configuration; no assignment to the station.
scope.body_during_read_only: native self test applies only to observed current joints; unmatched sample poses unknown

nominal_pillar_control.scope: Only the archived nominal stand versus the native simulator forearm; original environment and physical fixture remain separate.
